title: The drug scene among Los Angeles musicians
summary: Moore says drug use was around but not yet a big problem, and he used it only to be part of the crowd.

story.theme_name: Drink, drugs and the bandstand's casualties
story.community_name: Drugs and drink on the bandstand and the road

blocks.x: Yeah, right. These were my experiences in Los Angeles before I left and --

Well, tell me something, Chief, at that time you say you begin to get involved just briefly in the drug scene, but how was the drug scene out there at that time among the musicians? Was it something that was starting to develop as it seems that in the 1940s we hear about so many musicians.

All around town, but it wasn't quite a big problem yet as it is now. We knew who was using it and I don't know where the supply comes from, but I tried it for a while just to be in with the crowd but it never -- I never got used to it, so I left it alone a few more years and it wasn't too much of a problem for me. I could take it or leave it, you know, just be in with the in-crowd.
